{{Top|leg}}
'''Locking clamps''' were components used in the [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|defender sporting blaster pistol]]. The weapon could break down into three pieces for easy concealment. This was achieved by entering a three-digit code into an access panel located above the trigger. Once entered, the locking clamps and [[magnetic fastener]]s released and disassembled the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
